title: Rust Clean Refactor Wave 2 — Kernel 3D Scene, Kernel 3D Spatial, Fem Core
description: Wave 2 of repo-wide Rust cleanup campaign (zero rustc/clippy warnings, Result<_,String> migrated to thiserror, non-test panics reduced) for exactly these crates in order: kernel/3d/scene/rs, kernel/3d/spatial/rs, fem/core/rs. Apply tiers T1 (mechanical warnings/dead-code/allow-cleanup), T2 (thiserror error enums, &Vec<T> -> &[T]), T3 (panic reduction) in order per crate; T4 clones are report-only for this batch. Coordinate via campaign folder LOCKS/API-CHANGELOG/CONFLICTS/BLOCKERS files at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ueli-Documents-semio/ed30c89d-3941-44d3-ae21-abf565db2f2f/scratchpad/rust-clean-refactor-campaign, verify each crate with cargo clippy -D warnings and cargo test before moving on.
summary: Audited all 3 assigned crates (kernel/3d/scene/rs, kernel/3d/spatial/rs, fem/core/rs) against the campaign's T1-T3 tiers (T4 report-only). kernel/3d/scene/rs: fixed 12 distinct clippy warnings (9x chunks_exact_to_as_chunks, 2x question_mark, 1x unnecessary_map_or, 1x needless_range_loop, 2x too_many_arguments justified with reason= since screen_select_components/screen_select_instances are called from infinite/world/rs outside scope), restructured 2 non-test panicking .expect() sites in marquee helpers into graceful is_some_and() (an empty/canceled marquee polygon no longer panics), no Result<_,String> or &Vec<T> existed. kernel/3d/spatial/rs: fixed 1 needless_range_loop, documented 4 already-justified provably-infallible .expect() sites in Bvh::build_node with short invariant comments, no Result<_,String> or &Vec<T> existed. fem/core/rs: converted the existing hand-rolled FemError (manual Display+Error impls) to #[derive(thiserror::Error)] (non-breaking, same variants/Display text, added thiserror=2.0.12 dependency), removed the now-unused std::fmt import; all unwrap/expect/panic sites were already test-only. All three files were reformatted wholesale with cargo fmt to match the root max_width=250 config (pre-existing drift, whitespace-only). T4 clone audit (report-only) found only ordinary owned-String/struct clones in all three crates, no changes made. No API-CHANGELOG entries needed (no breaking public signature changes — the two allow-justified signatures and the FemError mechanism change are all additive/non-breaking). cargo clippy -p <pkg> --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test -p <pkg> both pass clean for all 3 crates; courtesy cargo check -p fem_2d -p fem_3d confirms the FemError change doesn't break downstream consumers. Full per-crate reports in the campaign reports/ folder. One coordination note: mid-verification an unrelated concurrent session's gis/2d/rs -> framework/surface/tiled-map/rs rename transiently broke whole-workspace cargo metadata for a few minutes (unrelated to these 3 crates); worked around with a direct rustfmt invocation and re-verified once it cleared.
